## What this region is

The one audit log for the slow-moving slices of a Warden call: every change to an instruction or knowledge source as a source version with actor and cause, every distinct composed slot as a composition version, and recompose to rebuild the exact text a call received from those ids.

## What it exists for

- Record and replay which instruction versions a Warden call saw
- Store a slice that changes per call

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- this Warden reads the whole org CLAUDE.md and shouldn't → composition
- shrink the Warden rows when the turn ends → threads-journal
- undo the line that feedback wrote into the rules file → feedback
- the settings patch didn't merge the nested key → settings-runtime
- send the reduced entries to the hosted Archive → archive
